title: NO MORE ELYTRA
description: Elytra are OP. Time to get rid of them FOREVER.
body:
Just get rid of elytra.
It's pretty simple.
# NOTE!
ONLY REMOVES ELYTRA ***ON PLAYER.*** WILL NOT REMOVE ELYTRA FROM:
- Chest
- Item Frame
- Ender Chest (If you somehow get it in there)
- Or anything that is not a player.
